question: 一共有多少个客户？
sql: select count(*) from demo_customers

question: 一共有多少种商品？
sql: select count(*) from demo_products

question: 一共有多少笔订单？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders

question: 已支付的订单有多少笔？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders where status = 'paid'

question: 退款订单有多少笔？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders where status = 'refunded'

question: 已支付订单的销售额合计是多少？
sql: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from demo_orders where status = 'paid'

question: 已支付订单的平均金额是多少？
sql: select round(avg(amount), 2) from demo_orders where status = 'paid'

question: 最大的一笔订单金额是多少？
sql: select max(amount) from demo_orders

question: 商品的平均单价是多少？
sql: select round(avg(price), 2) from demo_products

question: 华东区有多少个客户？
sql: select count(*) from demo_customers where region = '华东'

question: 华南区已支付订单的销售额是多少？
sql: select coalesce(sum(o.amount), 0) from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.region = '华南' and o.status = 'paid'

question: 华北区的订单数是多少？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.region = '华北'

question: 西南区有多少个客户？
sql: select count(*) from demo_customers where region = '西南'

question: 企业客户有多少个？
sql: select count(*) from demo_customers where segment = '企业'

question: 个人客户的订单数是多少？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.segment = '个人'

question: 电子品类有多少种商品？
sql: select count(*) from demo_products where category = '电子'

question: 办公品类的已支付销售额是多少？
sql: select coalesce(sum(o.amount), 0) from demo_orders o join demo_products p on o.product_id = p.id where p.category = '办公' and o.status = 'paid'

question: 家居品类的订单数是多少？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders o join demo_products p on o.product_id = p.id where p.category = '家居'

question: 整体退款率是多少（百分比）？
sql: select round(100.0 * sum(case when status = 'refunded' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) from demo_orders

question: 华东区的退款率是多少（百分比）？
sql: select round(100.0 * sum(case when o.status = 'refunded' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.region = '华东'

question: 企业客户的客单价是多少？
sql: select round(avg(o.amount), 2) from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where c.segment = '企业' and o.status = 'paid'

question: 销量最高的商品名称是什么？
sql: select p.name from demo_orders o join demo_products p on o.product_id = p.id where o.status = 'paid' group by p.name order by sum(o.quantity) desc limit 1

question: 销售额最高的品类是什么？
sql: select p.category from demo_orders o join demo_products p on o.product_id = p.id where o.status = 'paid' group by p.category order by sum(o.amount) desc limit 1

question: 单价最高的商品名称是什么？
sql: select name from demo_products order by price desc limit 1

question: 2026-04-07 当天及之后（含当天）的订单有多少笔？
sql: select count(*) from demo_orders where created_at >= '2026-04-07'

question: 2026-04-07 当天及之后（含当天）已支付订单的销售额是多少？
sql: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from demo_orders where status = 'paid' and created_at >= '2026-04-07'

question: 下单超过 1 次的复购客户有多少个？
sql: select count(*) from (select customer_id from demo_orders group by customer_id having count(*) > 1) t

question: 复购率是多少（百分比）？
sql: select round(100.0 * (select count(*) from (select customer_id from demo_orders group by customer_id having count(*) > 1) t) / (select count(distinct customer_id) from demo_orders), 2)

question: 订单数最多的区域是哪个？
sql: select c.region from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id group by c.region order by count(*) desc limit 1

question: 销售额最高的区域是哪个？
sql: select c.region from demo_orders o join demo_customers c on o.customer_id = c.id where o.status = 'paid' group by c.region order by sum(o.amount) desc limit 1
